// Dean's List volunteers form (Al Yamamah University).
// Serves the page below (PAGE) and appends each submission to the responses sheet.

const SHEET_ID = '17TxfWNiiG5lEytce2LzBXW4_mx2AH7cAb7_12uFoLw8';
const TAB = 'المتطوعون';
const HEADERS = ['وقت التسجيل', 'الاسم الثلاثي (عربي)', 'Full name (English)', 'الرقم الجامعي', 'رقم الجوال'];

// Set to false to close registration (the page then shows "registration closed").
const OPEN = true;

function doGet() {
  const html = OPEN
    ? PAGE.replace(/<!--CLOSED-->[\s\S]*?<!--\/CLOSED-->/, '')
    : PAGE.replace(/<!--OPEN-->[\s\S]*?<!--\/OPEN-->/, '');
  return HtmlService.createHtmlOutput(html)
    .setTitle('التطوع في فعالية قائمة العميد | جامعة اليمامة')
    .addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1');
}

function sheet_() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SHEET_ID);
  if (ss.getSpreadsheetTimeZone() !== 'Asia/Riyadh') ss.setSpreadsheetTimeZone('Asia/Riyadh');
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(TAB);
  if (!sh) {
    sh = ss.getSheets()[0];
    sh.setName(TAB);
  }
  if (sh.getLastRow() === 0) {
    sh.appendRow(HEADERS);
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);
    sh.setRightToLeft(true);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, HEADERS.length)
      .setFontWeight('bold').setBackground('#F76902').setFontColor('#FFFFFF');
    sh.getRange('D:E').setNumberFormat('@'); // keep leading zeros
    sh.setColumnWidths(1, HEADERS.length, 190);
  }
  return sh;
}

// Arabic-Indic / Persian digits -> ASCII.
function digits_(s) {
  return String(s || '').replace(/[٠-٩]/g, d => d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x660)
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, d => d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x6F0);
}

function words_(s) {
  return String(s || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function phone_(s) {
  let p = digits_(s).replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
  if (p.startsWith('00966')) p = p.slice(5);
  else if (p.startsWith('966')) p = p.slice(3);
  if (p.length === 9 && p.startsWith('5')) p = '0' + p;
  return /^05\d{8}$/.test(p) ? p : '';
}

function submit(d) {
  d = d || {};
  if (!OPEN) return { ok: false, error: 'closed' };
  if (d.website) return { ok: true }; // honeypot: bots fill it, people never see it

  const nameAr = words_(d.name_ar);
  const nameEn = words_(d.name_en);
  const id = digits_(d.student_id).replace(/\D/g, '');
  const phone = phone_(d.phone);

  if (!/^[\u0600-\u06FF\s]+$/.test(nameAr) || nameAr.split(' ').length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'name_ar' };
  if (!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'\-. ]*$/.test(nameEn) || nameEn.split(' ').length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'name_en' };
  if (!/^\d{6,12}$/.test(id)) return { ok: false, error: 'student_id' };
  if (!phone) return { ok: false, error: 'phone' };

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(20000);
  try {
    const sh = sheet_();
    const last = sh.getLastRow();
    if (last > 1) {
      const ids = sh.getRange(2, 4, last - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
      if (ids.some(r => String(r[0]).trim() === id)) return { ok: false, error: 'duplicate' };
    }
    // Leading apostrophe stores ID and phone as text so the 0 in 05... is kept.
    sh.appendRow([new Date(), nameAr, nameEn, "'" + id, "'" + phone]);
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

// ---------- the form page ----------
const PAGE = String.raw`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<base target="_top">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --orange:#F76902; --orange-2:#F68938; --orange-soft:#FEF0E6;
    --ink:#1E1E1E; --ink-2:#393939; --muted:#6B6B6B; --line:#E4DFDA;
    --paper:#FFFFFF; --bg:#F4EFEC; --err:#C62828; --ok:#1B7F4B;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{margin:0}
  body{
    font-family:"Cairo",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif;
    background:var(--bg); color:var(--ink); line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; min-height:100vh;
  }
  [data-l]{display:none}
  html[lang="ar"] [data-l="ar"], html[lang="en"] [data-l="en"]{display:revert}

  .band{height:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-2) 60%,#FBB351)}
  .top{
    max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 16px 0;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  }
  .logo{height:46px;width:auto;display:block}
  .lang{
    font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-2);
    background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;
    padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;
  }
  .lang:hover{border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange)}
  .lang:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(247,105,2,.35);outline-offset:2px}

  main{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 16px 40px}
  .card{
    background:var(--paper);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05),0 8px 28px rgba(57,57,57,.08);
  }
  .head{padding:24px 24px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
  .head::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:0;top:24px;bottom:20px;width:4px;
    background:var(--orange);border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;
  }
  html[dir="rtl"] .head::before{border-radius:4px 0 0 4px}
  .kicker{margin:0;color:var(--orange);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.02em}
  html[lang="ar"] .kicker{letter-spacing:0}
  h1{margin:2px 0 8px;font-size:clamp(22px,5.4vw,28px);line-height:1.3;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
  .lede{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
  .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:16px;padding:0;list-style:none}
  .meta li{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    background:var(--orange-soft);color:var(--ink-2);
    border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
  }
  .meta svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex:none;color:var(--orange)}

  form{padding:8px 24px 24px}
  .field{padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
  .field:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
  label.lbl{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
  label.lbl .req{color:var(--orange);margin-inline-start:2px}
  .hint{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:-2px 0 8px}
  input[type=text],input[type=tel]{
    width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);
    background:#FCFBFA;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;
    padding:11px 14px;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s,background .15s;
  }
  input::placeholder{color:#A9A39E}
  input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--orange);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(247,105,2,.12)}
  .ltr{direction:ltr;text-align:left}
  html[dir="rtl"] .ltr::placeholder{text-align:right}
  .field.bad input{border-color:var(--err);background:#FFF8F8}
  .err{display:none;color:var(--err);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-top:6px}
  .field.bad .err{display:block}

  .consent{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:16px 0 4px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-2);cursor:pointer}
  .consent input{width:20px;height:20px;margin:2px 0 0;accent-color:var(--orange);flex:none}
  .consent.bad{color:var(--err)}

  .hp{position:absolute!important;inset-inline-start:-10000px;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden}

  .actions{margin-top:20px}
  .btn{
    width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;
    background:var(--orange);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 18px;cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(247,105,2,.25);transition:background .15s,transform .1s;
  }
  .btn:hover{background:#E05E00}
  .btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
  .btn[disabled]{opacity:.65;cursor:progress}
  .status{min-height:22px;margin:12px 0 0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;text-align:center}
  .status.bad{color:var(--err)}

  .done{display:none;padding:40px 24px 36px;text-align:center}
  .done .tick{
    width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 12px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--orange-soft);display:grid;place-items:center;
  }
  .done .tick svg{width:32px;height:32px;color:var(--orange)}
  .done h2{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:22px}
  .done p{margin:0 auto;color:var(--muted);max-width:420px}
  .card.sent form{display:none}
  .card.sent .done{display:block}

  .closed{padding:32px 24px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:700}

  footer{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 28px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#8C8580}

  @media (max-width:420px){
    .head{padding:20px 18px 18px}
    .head::before{top:20px;bottom:18px}
    form{padding:4px 18px 20px}
    .logo{height:38px}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="band" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<header class="top">
  <img class="logo" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="جامعة اليمامة — Al Yamamah University">
  <button type="button" class="lang" id="langBtn"><span data-l="ar">English</span><span data-l="en">العربية</span></button>
</header>

<main>
  <section class="card" id="card" aria-labelledby="title">
    <div class="head">
      <p class="kicker"><span data-l="ar">دعوة للتطوع</span><span data-l="en">Call for volunteers</span></p>
      <h1 id="title"><span data-l="ar">التطوع في فعالية قائمة العميد</span><span data-l="en">Volunteer at the Dean’s List event</span></h1>
      <p class="lede"><span data-l="ar">سجّل بياناتك للانضمام إلى فريق تنظيم الفعالية.</span><span data-l="en">Leave your details to join the event’s organizing team.</span></p>
      <ul class="meta">
        <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="4.5" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M3 9.5h18M8 2.5v4M16 2.5v4"/></svg><span data-l="ar">الخميس ٥ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦</span><span data-l="en">Thursday, 5 November 2026</span></li>
        <li><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg><span data-l="ar">١٢:٠٠ ظهرًا – ٢:٠٠ مساءً</span><span data-l="en">12:00 – 2:00 PM</span></li>
      </ul>
    </div>

    <!--OPEN-->
    <form id="form" novalidate>
      <div class="field" data-f="name_ar">
        <label class="lbl" for="name_ar"><span data-l="ar">الاسم الثلاثي بالعربي</span><span data-l="en">Full name in Arabic (3 parts)</span><span class="req" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <input type="text" id="name_ar" name="name_ar" dir="rtl" autocomplete="off" placeholder="مثال: محمد عبدالله العتيبي" required aria-describedby="e_name_ar">
        <span class="err" id="e_name_ar"><span data-l="ar">اكتب اسمك الثلاثي بالحروف العربية.</span><span data-l="en">Enter your three-part name in Arabic letters.</span></span>
      </div>

      <div class="field" data-f="name_en">
        <label class="lbl" for="name_en"><span data-l="ar">الاسم الثلاثي بالإنجليزي</span><span data-l="en">Full name in English (3 parts)</span><span class="req" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <input type="text" id="name_en" name="name_en" class="ltr" dir="ltr" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="words" placeholder="e.g. Mohammed Abdullah Alotaibi" required aria-describedby="e_name_en">
        <span class="err" id="e_name_en"><span data-l="ar">اكتب اسمك الثلاثي بالحروف الإنجليزية.</span><span data-l="en">Enter your three-part name in English letters.</span></span>
      </div>

      <div class="field" data-f="student_id">
        <label class="lbl" for="student_id"><span data-l="ar">الرقم الجامعي</span><span data-l="en">University ID</span><span class="req" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <input type="text" id="student_id" name="student_id" class="ltr" dir="ltr" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" placeholder="2024XXXXX" required aria-describedby="e_student_id">
        <span class="err" id="e_student_id"><span data-l="ar">الرقم الجامعي أرقام فقط.</span><span data-l="en">Your university ID should be numbers only.</span></span>
      </div>

      <div class="field" data-f="phone">
        <label class="lbl" for="phone"><span data-l="ar">رقم الجوال</span><span data-l="en">Mobile number</span><span class="req" aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <input type="tel" id="phone" name="phone" class="ltr" dir="ltr" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="05XXXXXXXX" required aria-describedby="e_phone">
        <span class="err" id="e_phone"><span data-l="ar">اكتب رقم جوال سعودي صحيح يبدأ بـ 05.</span><span data-l="en">Enter a valid Saudi mobile number starting with 05.</span></span>
      </div>

      <div class="hp" aria-hidden="true">
        <label for="website">Website</label>
        <input type="text" id="website" name="website" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
      </div>

      <label class="consent" id="consentRow">
        <input type="checkbox" id="consent">
        <span><span data-l="ar">أؤكد صحة بياناتي والتزامي بالحضور في الموعد المحدد.</span><span data-l="en">I confirm my details are correct and I’ll attend at the set time.</span></span>
      </label>

      <div class="actions">
        <button type="submit" class="btn" id="submitBtn"><span data-l="ar">تسجيل</span><span data-l="en">Register</span></button>
        <p class="status" id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </div>
    </form>

    <div class="done" id="done" tabindex="-1">
      <div class="tick" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5"/></svg></div>
      <h2><span data-l="ar">تم تسجيلك بنجاح</span><span data-l="en">You’re registered</span></h2>
      <p><span data-l="ar">شكرًا لك! سنتواصل معك على رقم جوالك بالتفاصيل قبل الفعالية.</span><span data-l="en">Thank you! We’ll contact you on your mobile with the details before the event.</span></p>
    </div>
    <!--/OPEN--><!--CLOSED-->
    <p class="closed"><span data-l="ar">اكتمل العدد — أُغلق التسجيل. شكرًا لاهتمامك.</span><span data-l="en">Registration is now closed. Thank you for your interest.</span></p>
    <!--/CLOSED-->
  </section>
</main>

<footer><span data-l="ar">جامعة اليمامة · فعالية قائمة العميد ٢٠٢٦</span><span data-l="en">Al Yamamah University · Dean’s List 2026</span></footer>

<script>
(function(){
  var html = document.documentElement;
  var MSG = {
    ar:{sending:'جارٍ الإرسال…', fix:'فضلًا صحّح الحقول المظللة.', consent:'فضلًا أكّد على الإقرار.', dup:'هذا الرقم الجامعي مسجّل مسبقًا.', closed:'أُغلق التسجيل.', fail:'تعذّر الإرسال، حاول مرة أخرى.'},
    en:{sending:'Sending…', fix:'Please fix the highlighted fields.', consent:'Please tick the confirmation box.', dup:'This university ID is already registered.', closed:'Registration is closed.', fail:'Couldn’t send. Please try again.'}
  };
  var TITLE = {ar:'التطوع في فعالية قائمة العميد | جامعة اليمامة', en:'Volunteer — Dean’s List | Al Yamamah University'};

  function lang(){ return html.lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ar'; }
  function setLang(l){
    html.lang = l; html.dir = l === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
    document.title = TITLE[l];
    try { localStorage.setItem('yu-dl-lang', l); } catch(e){}
  }
  var saved = null;
  try { saved = localStorage.getItem('yu-dl-lang'); } catch(e){}
  setLang(saved === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ar');
  document.getElementById('langBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ setLang(lang() === 'ar' ? 'en' : 'ar'); });

  var form = document.getElementById('form');
  if (!form) return;

  function digits(s){
    return String(s||'').replace(/[٠-٩]/g, function(d){ return d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x660; })
                        .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function(d){ return d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x6F0; });
  }
  function squash(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); }
  function phone(s){
    var p = digits(s).replace(/\D/g,'');
    if (p.indexOf('00966') === 0) p = p.slice(5); else if (p.indexOf('966') === 0) p = p.slice(3);
    if (p.length === 9 && p.charAt(0) === '5') p = '0' + p;
    return /^05\d{8}$/.test(p) ? p : '';
  }
  var CHECK = {
    name_ar: function(v){ v = squash(v); return /^[؀-ۿ\s]+$/.test(v) && v.split(' ').length >= 3; },
    name_en: function(v){ v = squash(v); return /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'\-. ]*$/.test(v) && v.split(' ').length >= 3; },
    student_id: function(v){ return /^\d{6,12}$/.test(digits(v).replace(/\s/g,'')); },
    phone: function(v){ return !!phone(v); }
  };

  function field(n){ return form.querySelector('[data-f="'+n+'"]'); }
  function validate(n){
    var ok = CHECK[n](form.elements[n].value);
    field(n).classList.toggle('bad', !ok);
    form.elements[n].setAttribute('aria-invalid', ok ? 'false' : 'true');
    return ok;
  }
  Object.keys(CHECK).forEach(function(n){
    var el = form.elements[n];
    el.addEventListener('blur', function(){ if (el.value) validate(n); });
    el.addEventListener('input', function(){ if (field(n).classList.contains('bad')) validate(n); });
  });
  var consent = document.getElementById('consent'), consentRow = document.getElementById('consentRow');
  consent.addEventListener('change', function(){ consentRow.classList.toggle('bad', !consent.checked && consentRow.classList.contains('bad')); });

  var btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn'), status = document.getElementById('status');
  function say(key, bad){ status.textContent = key ? MSG[lang()][key] : ''; status.classList.toggle('bad', !!bad); status.dataset.key = key || ''; }
  document.getElementById('langBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){ if (status.dataset.key) say(status.dataset.key, status.classList.contains('bad')); });

  form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    var first = null;
    Object.keys(CHECK).forEach(function(n){ if (!validate(n) && !first) first = form.elements[n]; });
    if (first){ say('fix', true); first.focus(); return; }
    if (!consent.checked){ consentRow.classList.add('bad'); say('consent', true); consent.focus(); return; }
    consentRow.classList.remove('bad');

    var data = {
      name_ar: squash(form.elements.name_ar.value),
      name_en: squash(form.elements.name_en.value),
      student_id: digits(form.elements.student_id.value).replace(/\D/g,''),
      phone: phone(form.elements.phone.value),
      website: form.elements.website.value
    };
    btn.disabled = true; say('sending');
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function(res){
        btn.disabled = false;
        if (res && res.ok){
          say('');
          document.getElementById('card').classList.add('sent');
          document.getElementById('done').focus();
          window.scrollTo(0,0);
          return;
        }
        var err = res && res.error;
        if (err === 'duplicate'){ field('student_id').classList.add('bad'); say('dup', true); form.elements.student_id.focus(); }
        else if (err === 'closed'){ say('closed', true); }
        else if (err && CHECK[err]){ field(err).classList.add('bad'); say('fix', true); form.elements[err].focus(); }
        else say('fail', true);
      })
      .withFailureHandler(function(){ btn.disabled = false; say('fail', true); })
      .submit(data);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
`;
